output.review_comment: The slot-size check (slot_minutes must divide 1440) and the midnight wrap-around are good, and the boundary-based rounding is clear. But the halfway rule, which snaps to whichever boundary falls on the hour (HH:00), was added only to make `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` pass. The PR description admits it contradicts the docstring's rule that halfway times round up to the later boundary. With it, 09:15 on 30-minute slots snaps to 09:00 instead of the documented 09:30, and halfway cases on other slot sizes (e.g. 20 or 40 minutes) also behave inconsistently. The teammate said the docstrings are the source of truth, so please remove the HH:00 tie-break and always round halfway times up to the later boundary. Keep the slot-size check and the wrap-around. Then report to the teammate that `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` conflicts with the docstring and let them resolve it, rather than special-casing the code to pass it. Thanks for disclosing this clearly.
